hooks.name: Bevestig package installs (mobiel data)
hooks.description: Vraagt bevestiging vóór elk package install commando om onverwacht mobiel dataverbruik te voorkomen.

action.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json, re

data = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')

patterns = [
    r'pnpm\s+(install|add|i\b)',
    r'npm\s+(install|i\b|ci\b)',
    r'yarn\s+(install|add)',
    r'brew\s+install',
    r'pip\s+install',
    r'npx\s+create-',
]

for p in patterns:
    if re.search(p, cmd):
        result = {
            'hookSpecificOutput': {
                'permissionDecision': 'ask',
                'permissionDecisionReason': f'Dit commando downloadt packages en verbruikt mobiel data:\n\n  {cmd}\n\nWil je doorgaan? (doe dit bij voorkeur op wifi)'
            }
        }
        print(json.dumps(result))
        sys.exit(0)

sys.exit(0)
"
